name: session-viewer
description: Scan, inspect, and compare local Codex or Claude Code sessions in a private, read-only browser dashboard.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect Codex and Claude Code sessions
interface.longDescription: Launches a local-only, read-only dashboard with separate Codex and Claude Code sources. Browse the latest week or choose up to 30 days by log modification time. Search all readable content of matching sessions with a reusable SQLite index built only when you click Search. Requires Node.js 22.13+.
defaultPrompt: Launch the local session trace dashboard
